page.layout: One text column with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number 249 at top right. Heading in italic centred above the second paragraph. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: puellas & virgines non pertinere, sed ad fœminas tantum viris jam denuptas. Nam illas sic educatas, & hujusmodi disciplinæ subjectas fuisse, cujusmodi ante exposita est, camque rationem ad ultima civitatis Laconicæ tempora durasse, nemo negare potest; nec id Plato & Aristoteles inficiantur, sed tantum de fœminis loquuntur maritatis.

SAtis de iis, qui juniorum nomine censebantur. Quæ sequuntur, ad ætatem matrimonio, & gerendæ reipublicæ maturam pertinent. Eam ætatem cæpisse in maribus ab anno vitæ xx[illegible, ~3 letters]; ob magnas rationes mihi quidem dubium non est: in sexu altero initium habuisse à xx, verosimillimum existimo. De nuptiis quidem sic statuisse Lycurgum ferunt, ne ante ætatis robur inire eas liceret, & causam addidisse[illegible, ~4 letters] ut ex validis validi liberi gignerentur, ne ex infirmis ac immaturis infirma proles suscieretur. Quò & cætera instituta ejus de matrimoniis relata fuisse videntur. Qualia erant hæc, ut sponsæ à sponsis sine dote peterentur, ut [illegible, ~2 letters] cum paribus se jungerent, ut sponsæ ex-peterentur & ante alias probarentur,[illegible, ~3 letters]

page.notes: Right margin: several marginal notes are only faint red-stained marks and cannot be read; they are shown as illegible placeholders at their approximate positions. The line "ut pa" at the end of the sixth line is obscured by a red stain, so its letters are marked illegible. "suscieretur" is printed as "susciperetur" with the p worn, so the reading of the second part is doubtful and may be a printing error; the text as shown follows the visible letters. Show-through from the facing page appears on the right edge and is not transcribed. The catchword at the lower right is only partly visible.
